name: Sheba
overview: The name Sheba appears in Scripture referring to various descendants and locations, highlighting its significance in biblical genealogies and geography. Sheba is identified as a son of Raamah, a son of Joktan, and a son of Jokshan, illustrating its connection to different tribal lineages (Genesis 10:7, 10:28, 25:3; 1 Chronicles 1:9, 1:22). Additionally, Sheba is associated with a city in the territory of Simeon, also known as Beersheba, marking its importance in the inheritance of Israel (Joshua 19:2). These references collectively point to Sheba as both a people and place of notable historical and prophetic relevance within God's unfolding plan.
